text: DESK-1 (10-8): Ref's Book version check becomes blocking — Ref refuses to run when claims.md and Ref disagree on the version, instead of printing both for a human to eyeball. Alex approved.

DESK-2 (10-8): numbers with a live source get live lookups with auto as-of dates instead of recurring manual asks (e.g. CL-050 Atlanta jobs count). Kills the class of 'needs a number', not each instance. Alex approved.

DESK-3 (10-8): Quinn's send logging becomes one tap — tapping Use on a desk card logs the send (card id + date) in the same motion, replacing the manual 'tell the Muse you sent it' step. Alex approved.
